title: Elliott & Setton 2001 equilibrium stress-strain, representative AF sample (circumferential, axial)

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: equilibrium nominal stress vs optical strain of ONE representative AF (same disc) in circumferential and axial orientations

source.sample: 60 planar AF samples from 10 fresh-frozen non-degenerate lumbar discs (L1-L2, L2-L3) of 7 donors; outer and inner anterior AF

protocol.summary: Planar AF strips (thickness 1.37+-0.30, width 2.86+-0.35, length 7.73+-1.23 mm; n=60) microtomed from anterior outer/inner AF blocks, orientations circumferential (groups 1-2, 1-3), axial (2-1, 2-3), radial (3-1); equilibrated 30 min in 0.15 M PBS (free swelling), tested in 0.15 M PBS bath; sandpaper grips; tare 0.008 MPa for 10 min; preconditioning 10 cycles 0-2% strain at 0.002 /s; incremental stress-relaxation: circumferential 1% (or 2%) grip-strain steps at 0.0001 /s to 20%, axial/radial 4% steps at 0.0002 /s to 40%, 15 min relaxation each; equilibrium stress = force / initial area vs optical (marker-triad) Lagrangian/infinitesimal strain; bilinear fit gives E0 (toe) and E (linear), transition e*.
how_to_simulate: Build a strip model 7.73 x 2.86 x 1.37 mm with fibre architecture of the anterior outer (or inner) AF oriented as tested; grip both ends
Apply stepwise grip strain and evaluate equilibrium (fully relaxed) response; free-swollen state in 0.15 M PBS
Compute nominal stress (force / initial area) vs local surface strain in the central region; fit bilinear model for E0 and E

extraction.check_notes: Markers digitised visually from 200-dpi crop with axis calibration (x: 0-0.5, y: 0-1.0 MPa). Re-check: diamond at 0.083 lies at the 0.6 tick level (0.601 vs 0.615 read) - within uncertainty. Site of the representative sample not stated (assumed outer). Strain unit is fraction.

pass_rule.rule: model curve inside the measured corridor (mean +/- 1 SD or min-max) over the tested range
